duel.title: The Duel
duel.tagline: Write a piece. Then send its words against the one Gulliver has already written.
duel.rule_1: Gulliver has written his piece for today’s prompt. Nobody can read it yet.
duel.rule_2: Write your own piece, then send some of its words against his. Only your own words count — his are greyed out. The pot is your writing: a longer piece plays for more, and fewer words sent means more per hit.
duel.rule_3: Then he rewrites his piece without a single word you sent.
duel.note: Small words — the, and, to be — never count. Only words of four letters or more.
duel.signin: Sign in to play today's duel.
duel.prepare_failed: Gulliver could not write today. Try again in a little while.
duel.unavailable: The duel is not open right now. Come back a little later.
duel.placeholder: Write here, in your own words…
duel.too_short: Write at least {n} words before you send any.
duel.truncated: {total} words in all. Only the first {n} go into the duel.
duel.pick_one: Pick at least one word to send: move the slider or tap a word.
duel.too_long: A duel takes {n} words at most. Reload the page and send again: the first {n} will count.
duel.choose_body: Pick words from your own piece to forbid him; the prompt’s words are greyed out. The slider is your wager: slide it down to send fewer words for a bigger pay. Tap a word to add it or take it back. Nothing is sent until you lock in.
duel.lock_hint: This sends them and locks the round. It cannot be undone.
duel.locked_notice: Locked. Play another round whenever you like.
duel.muzzle_line: Muzzle: {pct}% of what he wanted to say is now off-limits.
duel.muzzle_none: He never reached for one of your words.
duel.she_wrote_note: His hidden piece. Your hits are marked.
duel.rewriting: He is rewriting his piece without your words…
duel.rewrite_pass: He is rewriting his piece without your words… (pass {n} of {total})
duel.clean: He managed it: not one of your words.
duel.rewrite_failed: The rewrite did not come through.
duel.copy_failed: Could not copy — select the result instead.
duel.board_empty: No one has locked a duel in this language yet today.
duel.already_locked: That round is already locked. Here it is.
duel.rope_bad: Those words are not in your piece. Check what you selected.

hub.title: Today's games
siege.tagline: You and your friends against Gulliver, behind one code.
siege.signin: Sign in to play a siege.
siege.rule_1: Share a code to enter the same room. Each of you writes a piece for today's prompt and locks the words to send.
siege.rule_2: When everyone has locked, all your words go against Gulliver together. A hit only you found counts +2. A hit you all found counts +1 per player. Words from the prompt earn no bonus.
siege.rule_3: Then he rewrites his piece without a single word any of you sent.
siege.start_body: You get a code to share with the people you want to play with: up to {n} of you in all.
siege.join_body: Type the code you were given.
siege.join_room_body: {n} of {max} places are taken. It is played in {lang}.
siege.no_day: There is nothing of this room on that day.
siege.no_room: No siege has that code. Check it and try again.
siege.not_a_member: You are not in this room.
siege.too_many: You have started enough rooms for today. Join one instead.
siege.too_many_rooms: You are in {n} rooms already, which is the most.
siege.too_many_attempts: Enough tries for today. Ask for the code.
siege.link_copied: Link copied. Send it to your friends.
siege.copy_failed: Could not copy it. The link is in the address bar.
siege.sit_out_confirm: Sit out today's siege? The others can go on without you.
siege.sit_back_in_body: You are sitting out today's siege. You can count yourself back in until you lock.
siege.leave_confirm: Leave this room for good? You will need the code again to come back.
siege.waiting_for_many: Waiting for {n} more: {locked} of {total} have locked.
siege.waiting_note: It resolves the moment everyone has locked. Whoever has not by the end of the day is left out.
siege.can_leave: You can close this page. Come back when the others have locked.
siege.lock_hint: This sends them and locks your words in. Then the room waits for the others.
siege.already_locked: Your words are already locked. Here they are.
siege.resolved: Resolved. Between you, {union} different words went against him.
siege.bonus_none: No bonus: no word was found by one player alone, or by all of you.
siege.she_wrote_note: His hidden piece for this room. Every hit anyone found is marked.
siege.muzzle_line: Between you, {pct}% of what he wanted to say is now off-limits.
siege.muzzle_none: He never reached for a word any of you sent.
siege.lapsed: Today's siege did not happen: fewer than two players locked in.
siege.late: Today's siege is already over. You can read how it went.
duel.meter_hint: Send eight or fewer and every hit pays far more.
duel.prompt_free: Grey words are his already — the prompt gave them to him.
duel.sent_contract: You sent {n} words — {name}. Each hit paid ×{pays}; score {score}.
duel.round_limit: Twelve rounds a day — even Gulliver rests. Come back tomorrow.
duel.spell_anyway: Names are not checked. Check the rest, or press send again to send anyway.
duel.bet_body: Your purse starts at 10 points, and every round’s score banks into it — this is where it is spent. Pick a word and stake points on this round’s hidden piece: that he uses it (×12) or that he never does (×1.5). Three stakes a round, settled when you lock.
duel.bet_on_absent: Staked {n} on “{word}” — he never uses it.
duel.purse_short: The purse is too light for that stake.
duel.bet_limit: Three stakes a round at most.
duel.jailbreak: Jailbreak +{n}: he smuggled {m} of your hostages back into his rewrite.
